name: Oklou
label: Because Music
lede: Marylou Mayniel trained as a cellist in Poitiers, spent a decade in Paris DJ crews and laptop cassettes, and then made the debut album Pitchfork ranked fourth in the world for 2025.

eras.title: Cello first, laptop later
eras.text: Marylou Mayniel grows up in rural western France on classical training and her parents' folk dances, then teaches herself production and lands in Paris. By 2015 she is putting out her own tapes and running a DJ crew.

years.big: Showed me what I didn't want to do, which is useful.
years.src: The Line of Best Fit · Crack Magazine
years.h: Poitiers, cello at 10, conservatory soon after
years.p: Marylou Mayniel (Oklou) was born April 23, 1993, started piano at 4 and got her first computer at 19. She told Crack the conservatory taught her what to avoid.
years.xp:
She told The Line of Best Fit she began piano at 4 and cello at 10, and that she is drawn to low-sounding instruments because the cello sits close to the human voice in frequency. Her parents loved folklore and traditional dance, and she grew up going to regional bal nights.

She later heard the same looping, communal trance in folk dance and in rave music.

years.h: As Loumar she puts out Avril, then moves to Paris and self-releases First Tape
years.p: Avril came out in June 2014. First Tape followed on November 23, 2015, with a limited cassette run.
years.xp: Both records were self-released. The Paris move put her in the city's young club scene, where she spent her early twenties immersing herself in rave history through YouTube documentaries and playlists, as she told Crack.

years.cap: TGAF (These Girls Are on Fiyah), Paris
years.src: Wikipedia: Oklou · The FADER: Female DJ
years.h: Four women start a radio show called TGAF
years.p: Oklou co-founded These Girls Are on Fiyah with DJ Ouai, Miley Serious and Carin Kelly. The crew ran weekly radio shows and Paris nights.
years.xp: The FADER counted TGAF among a wave of female DJ crews alongside Discwoman. The group folded in July 2018.

eras.title: She meets Casey, then gets a label
eras.text: A producer from Montreal becomes the partnership behind everything she makes next. Her first release on a label arrives in 2018.

years.cap: Casey Manierka-Quaile performing at the Canadian Film Centre Garden Party, Toronto, June 22, 2016
q: He legit really helped me achieve my visions.
years.h: Red Bull Music Academy puts her in a room with Casey Manierka-Quaile
years.p: The Canadian producer Casey Manierka-Quaile (Casey MQ) became her closest collaborator. Their first record, For the Beasts, came in December 2017.
years.xp:
Sources disagree on the setting: Wikipedia places the meeting at a 2016 Red Bull Music Academy residency in Montreal, while Crack describes it as the 2015 Paris edition. The partnership itself is not in dispute.

He is her main collaborator on Galore and choke enough a decade later.

years.h: The Rite of May is her first release on a label
years.p: The Rite of May came out March 16, 2018 on NUXXE, with help from Sega Bodega, Rodaidh McDonald, Krampf and Bok Bok.
years.xp:
Fact described the EP as dealing with identity, intimacy and faith through lush, experimental electronic production.

Four months later TGAF disbanded. She also made a video game with Krampf, Zone W/O People, for Red Bull Music Academy's Diggin' in the Carts event.

eras.title: Galore finds a bigger audience
eras.text: A mixtape made with Casey MQ reaches far beyond a cassette run and gets her a support slot across America.

q: About escaping your reality and trying to exist in another dimension.
years.src: Wikipedia: Oklou · The Line of Best Fit · Gorilla vs. Bear
years.h: Galore comes out on three labels at once
years.p: Because Music, TaP Records and True Panther Sounds shared the mixtape, which has A. G. Cook, Shygirl and Sega Bodega on the credits.
years.xp:
Cook co-produced "girl on my throne". Gorilla vs. Bear, Rough Trade and Dummy all put Galore on their 2020 year-end lists.

Oklou said it was made during an emotionally turbulent stretch: "you know when you're super sad you also feel super alive."

years.cap: Oklou opening for Caroline Polachek at Union Transfer, Philadelphia, December 2021
years.h: Caroline Polachek takes her on tour across the US
years.p: Oklou opened for Polachek in November and December 2021, a year after remixing Polachek's "Door".
years.xp: She also remixed Dua Lipa and Angèle's "Fever" in 2020 and Bladee and Mechatok's "Rainbow" in March 2021. The Galore Anniversary EP followed on October 13, 2021.

eras.title: Four years, then three singles in six weeks
eras.text: After touring and remixing since 2020, she puts out a run of singles that signals the album is coming.

years.h: "Family and Friends" is the first sign of the album
years.p: Casey MQ, Cecile Believe and Zsela add vocals, and Gil Gharbi directed the video.

years.big: A hypnotic Eurodance throwback that sounds as if you are clubbing in a medieval dungeon.
yt: harvest sky live at La Cigale, March 2025
years.h: "Harvest Sky" arrives with Underscores, backed by "Obvious"
years.p: Nylon's Lindsay Hattrick on the double A-side, a trance-pop track with Underscores that Oklou tied to the French midsummer festival La Fête de la Saint-Jean.
years.xp:
Oklou described "Harvest Sky" as her third attempt to talk about one moment in festivities: zooming out from the crowd into a lonely mental space.

Danny L Harle and Milkfish released extended remixes on December 18.

eras.title: Choke Enough
eras.text: The debut album arrives in February and ends the year on best-of lists on three continents.

years.src: Wikipedia: Take Me by the Hand
yt: take me by the hand ft. Bladee (official video)
years.p: After a Drain Gang show in Los Angeles, Oklou wanted Bladee or Ecco2k on a song. Bladee was the one who answered, and "Take Me by the Hand" got made.
years.xp:
The two already had history: Oklou remixed Bladee and Mechatok's "Rainbow" in 2021. Oklou and Casey MQ produced, Danny L Harle added production, and Tohé Commaret directed a video with Bladee as a ghostly light on a theater screen.

The FADER called it the best entry point for new listeners.

years.src: Wikipedia: Choke Enough · Stereogum: Oklou · Crack Magazine
years.h: choke enough took two and a half years and three cities
years.p: Oklou made the debut in Paris, Los Angeles and Cap Ferret with Casey MQ, Danny L Harle and A. G. Cook. Wikipedia lists Because Music and True Panther Sounds as the labels.
years.xp:
Metacritic scored it 84 from six reviews. Oklou told Stereogum: "It's pretty new for me to try and talk about adult things while still using this very childish music."

She also said the sessions with Casey often ended in dead ends over the concept of each song's words. The title track draws on a drive in Los Angeles where the music absorbed her so completely that driving became secondary. The album reached No. 83 in the UK and No. 12 in Scotland.

yt: blade bird live at La Cigale, March 2025
years.h: Two days before the album, "Blade Bird" is out
years.p: The FADER later made it its No. 1 song of the year. Oklou played it live at Paris's La Cigale in March.

years.h: Four more songs, one with FKA twigs
years.p: Choke Enough: Expansion Pack includes "viscus" with FKA twigs.
years.xp: The same month she appeared on a remix of PinkPantheress's "Girl Like Me". The Expansion Pack was a deluxe edition of the album, not a new one.

years.cap: Oklou live at The Academy, Dublin, December 3, 2025
years.src: Wikipedia: Choke Enough · Album of the Year · Chart Data · Franceinfo
yt: Pitchfork talks with Oklou: Choke Enough, touring and motherhood
years.h: Pitchfork gives it 8.0 and ranks it No. 4 of the year
years.p: The score comes from Wikipedia's reception box. Pitchfork described a fusion of Y2K worship, Baroque polyphony and opaque ambiance.
years.xp:
Album of the Year lists it at No. 1 on Crack, Gorilla vs. Bear and Time Out, No. 2 on Dazed, Les Inrocks, Rough Trade and The Atlantic, and No. 3 on Stereogum. In France, the Prix Joséphine named it album of the year in autumn 2025, per franceinfo.

Oklou announced her pregnancy in a Stereogum interview around release and her son Zakaria was born in June 2025, per Wikipedia.
